000c353551359cdd.prompt:
Write one complete phone screen as JSON: {id,title?,components:[{id,c,...props}]}. Use unique snake_case ids for components; never put ids on array items. Use only listed props. Use null for absent optional fields, never write empty strings.

Layout: tracker/timer. Job: Log an activity again and again.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Timer"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Note"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot4","allow":["Bars"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot5","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).
density: comfortable|compact
emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined
align: start|center
bleed: inset|edge
aspect: auto|square|wide|tall
detail: full|brief
media: none|icon|thumb|cover
figures: exact|short
labels: key|none|all
arrange: rows|grid|strip
group: none|sections|dates
overflow: all|peek|page
lead: none|icon|avatar|thumb|number|check
trail: none|chevron|value|badge|toggle|check
tone: neutral|good|warn|bad
mark: none|highlight|muted|new

An explicit layout rule can request an axis. Catalog examples show JSON shape, not requested styling. Never infer an axis from the data alone. Variant limits: one hero emphasis and one cover collection per screen.

Layout rule: Name the supplied activity in Header.title, e.g. Time your care session. Header.action, detail, density and emphasis are null; avoid a generic subtitle. Timer counts up from the supplied current seconds. The Note gives one clear sequence using the visible control labels: Start when you begin, Stop when finished, then Save session to review the saved entry. Note.media, tone, emphasis and density stay null.

Layout rule: Bars are context, not a second task: title them Recent session lengths and show only completed sessions, with each supplied minute value and three-letter day label. No padding or Today in Bars. Use one primary Button labeled Save session with goto session_saved; it does not duplicate Start or Stop.

Layout: home/feed. Job: What matters now.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Hero"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["List"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot4","allow":["Card"],"min":0,"max":1},{"id":"slot5","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).

emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined

Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Ring"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Checklist"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot4","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).

emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined

bleed: inset|edge
aspect: auto|square|wide|tall
detail: full|brief
media: none|icon|thumb|cover

labels: key|none|all

group: none|sections|dates
overflow: all|peek|page
lead: none|icon|avatar|thumb|number|check
trail: none|chevron|value|badge|toggle|check
tone: neutral|good|warn|bad
mark: none|highlight|muted|new

Layout: tracker/timer. Job: Log an activity again and again.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Timer"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Note"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot4","allow":["Bars"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot5","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).

emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined

Write one complete phone screen as JSON: {id,title?,components:[{id,c,...props}]}. Use unique snake_case ids for components; never put ids on array items. Use only listed props. Use null for absent optional fields, never write empty strings.

Layout: form/short. Job: Add or change a thing.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Field"],"min":3,"max":5},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).

Layout rule: Name the collection in Header.title. Set Header.action to literal null and tell the person in Header.sub that they can filter by category and tap a record to open it. Select All in Chips, add one unselected filter for each real category, and leave Chips.lead and every chip icon null.

Layout: capture/photo. Job: Take a picture or scan a code.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Camera"],"min":1,"max":1,"variant":"photo"},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Note"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot4","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).

bleed: inset|edge

labels: key|none|all

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Card"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).

surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined

Rule: Use style "number" when the main title is a headline number. Use media "cover" only when asked for a wide photo above the headline, and include its photo reference.

Timeline: Events in time order, or activities sized by duration on an hour rail.
props: { density?: comfortable|compact, detail?: full|brief="full", style?: day|history|hours="day", items: [1..8 { tone?: neutral|good|warn|bad="neutral", time: text≤12, title: text≤32, meta?: text≤32, done?: boolean=false, end?: time HH:MM, goto?: id snake_case }] }
Rule: Use day for a schedule of events with only single times, even if some are already done. Use history for an explicitly past-only log. Either takes up to six items. To show time and title only, set detail brief and keep supplied notes in meta.
Rule: Use hours for duration blocks on an hour rail: up to eight items, time as the start in HH:MM and a later end in HH:MM. Only hours uses end and goto; omit meta and done in hours.
Rule: Set density, detail and each event tone to null unless explicitly requested. Times, notes, completion and scheduling are data, not requests for a variant.

Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).

emphasis: quiet|normal|hero

Layout rule: Name the supplied activity in Header.title, e.g. Time your care session. Header.action, detail, density and emphasis are null; avoid a generic subtitle. Layout rule: Bars are context, not a second task: title them Recent session lengths and show only completed sessions, with each supplied minute value and three-letter day label. Layout: detail/facts. Job: One thing, fully.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["KeyValue"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Note"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot4","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).

Write one complete phone screen as JSON: {id,title?,components:[{id,c,...props}]}. Use unique snake_case ids for components; never put ids on array items. Use only listed props. Use null for absent optional fields, never write empty strings.

Layout: calendar/week. Job: Things by date.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Calendar"],"min":1,"max":1,"variant":"week"},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Timeline"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).
density: comfortable|compact
emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined
align: start|center
bleed: inset|edge
aspect: auto|square|wide|tall
detail: full|brief
media: none|icon|thumb|cover
figures: exact|short
labels: key|none|all
arrange: rows|grid|strip
group: none|sections|dates
overflow: all|peek|page
lead: none|icon|avatar|thumb|number|check
trail: none|chevron|value|badge|toggle|check
tone: neutral|good|warn|bad
mark: none|highlight|muted|new

An explicit layout rule can request an axis. Catalog examples show JSON shape, not requested styling. Never infer an axis from the data alone. Variant limits: one hero emphasis and one cover collection per screen.

Layout rule: Use only the supplied dated events and calendar month/start/days/selected values. Mark their event dates. Timeline uses day style with supplied times and titles, and the date and detail in meta. On EVERY Timeline item end, tone and goto must be literal null, even when time and title have values; do not replace those nulls with end times, status tones or links. This is not hours style. Header action is null.

Layout rule: Give the week a recognizable date in the Header and say what is scheduled. Arrange the supplied events in date and time order. Keep each item's supplied purpose or detail beside its date and time so the agenda says what each event is for.

Real app content: {"things":[{"type":"event","fields":["title","date","time","detail","month","start","days","selected"]}],"items":[{"id":"check_in","type":"event","sample":true,"title":"Check-in","date":"2026-11-18","time":"09:00","detail":"Routine review","month":"Nov 2026","start":7,"days":30,"selected":18},{"id":"follow_up","type":"event","sample":true,"title":"Follow-up","date":"2026-11-20","time":"14:30","detail":"Review next steps"}]}

Rule: Use style "back" only when a back button is needed. To hide a subtitle, use detail "brief" and keep the supplied subtitle in sub. Hiding it does not request a smaller title or a denser header: set emphasis and density to null unless the brief explicitly asks for those changes.

weight: 1

Calendar: See which dates have something planned and open a day.

Rule: Set density, detail and each event tone to null unless explicitly requested. Times, notes, completion and scheduling are data, not requests for a variant.

Write one complete phone screen as JSON: {id,title?,components:[{id,c,...props}]}. Use unique snake_case ids for components; never put ids on array items. Use only listed props. Use null for absent optional fields, never write empty strings.

Layout: list/grouped. Job: All things of one kind.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Chips"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["SectionTitle"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot4","allow":["List"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot5","allow":["SectionTitle"],"min":0,"max":1},{"id":"slot6","allow":["List"],"min":0,"max":1},{"id":"slot7","allow":["SectionTitle"],"min":0,"max":1},{"id":"slot8","allow":["List"],"min":0,"max":1},{"id":"slot9","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).
density: comfortable|compact
emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined
align: start|center
bleed: inset|edge
aspect: auto|square|wide|tall
detail: full|brief
media: none|icon|thumb|cover
figures: exact|short
labels: key|none|all
arrange: rows|grid|strip
group: none|sections|dates
overflow: all|peek|page
lead: none|icon|avatar|thumb|number|check
trail: none|chevron|value|badge|toggle|check
tone: neutral|good|warn|bad
mark: none|highlight|muted|new

An explicit layout rule can request an axis. Catalog examples show JSON shape, not requested styling. Never infer an axis from the data alone. Variant limits: one hero emphasis and one cover collection per screen.

Layout rule: Group every supplied record by its category field, once each, with no duplicates and no invented due dates. Use one SectionTitle and one List per group, up to three groups.

Layout rule: Keep each row’s supplied detail visible: leave detail, overflow, group and mark null. SectionTitle already names each group. Use the actual group names in the filter chips and leave the optional Header action null so the Button is the one main next action.

b093fbce91471028.prompt:
Write one complete phone screen as JSON: {id,title?,components:[{id,c,...props}]}. Use unique snake_case ids for components; never put ids on array items. Use only listed props. Use null for absent optional fields, never write empty strings.

Layout: calendar/month. Job: Things by date.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Calendar"],"min":1,"max":1,"variant":"month"},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Timeline"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).
density: comfortable|compact
emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined
align: start|center
bleed: inset|edge
aspect: auto|square|wide|tall
detail: full|brief
media: none|icon|thumb|cover
figures: exact|short
labels: key|none|all
arrange: rows|grid|strip
group: none|sections|dates
overflow: all|peek|page
lead: none|icon|avatar|thumb|number|check
trail: none|chevron|value|badge|toggle|check
tone: neutral|good|warn|bad
mark: none|highlight|muted|new

An explicit layout rule can request an axis. Catalog examples show JSON shape, not requested styling. Never infer an axis from the data alone. Variant limits: one hero emphasis and one cover collection per screen.

Layout rule: Use only the supplied dated events and calendar month/start/days/selected values. Mark their event dates. Timeline uses day style with supplied times and titles, and the date and detail in meta. On EVERY Timeline item end, tone and goto must be literal null, even when time and title have values; do not replace those nulls with end times, status tones or links. This is not hours style. Header action is null.

Layout rule: Use a short month-specific title such as “November appointments” in both title and Header.title. Keep Header.detail, density and emphasis null: show Header.sub and make the order obvious with one readable instruction, e.g. “Tap marked dates to see visits” (at most 40 characters). The Calendar supplies the selected date and the Timeline supplies that day's agenda.

Layout rule: Dots guide the person to visits: mark each supplied appointment date with tone good and leave other dates unmarked. Keep the supplied selection. The Timeline is that date’s agenda, not a second month list: show only its actual appointments in time order, with their exact titles and times. Put the purpose first and the friendly date second in meta, e.g. “Routine review · Nov 18”. Leave Timeline density and detail null.

Header: Name the screen and offer one optional shortcut.
props: { density?: comfortable|compact, emphasis?: normal|quiet="normal", detail?: full|brief="full", style?: back, title: text≤28, sub?: text≤40, action?: { icon: dot|leaf|drop|dog|cat|calendar|calendar_days|clock|check|chevron_right|plus|minus|close|search|settings|bell|bell_off|heart|star|bookmark|share|send|message|mail|phone|camera|image|video|mic|music|play|pause|square|undo|timer|alarm_clock|sun|moon|cloud|cloud_rain|thermometer|wind|flame|zap|battery|wifi|pin|map|navigation|compass|home|building|store|shopping_cart|shopping_bag|tag|gift|credit_card|wallet|banknote|piggy_bank|receipt|trending_up|trending_down|bar_chart|pie_chart|activity|target|trophy|medal|award|flag|user|users|user_plus|baby|smile|dumbbell|bike|footprints|heart_pulse|pill|stethoscope|apple|coffee|utensils|wine|pizza|carrot|sprout|flower|tree|mountain|waves|car|bus|plane|train|briefcase|graduation_cap|book_open|book|pencil|file_text|clipboard|clipboard_list|checklist|lock|unlock|key|shield|eye|link|paperclip|download|upload|trash|edit|filter|sliders|info|alert|help|sparkles|lightbulb|palette|scissors|wrench|hammer|package|truck|recycle|globe|languages|gamepad|ticket|paw|shirt|bed|bath|sofa|lamp|chevron_left|arrow_left|more|external_link|quote|circle_check, label: text≤16, goto?: id snake_case } }
Rule: Use style "back" only when a back button is needed. To hide a subtitle, use detail "brief" and keep the supplied subtitle in sub. Hiding it does not request a smaller title or a denser header: set emphasis and density to null unless the brief explicitly asks for those changes.
example: {"c":"Header","title":"My plants","sub":"Three need water today","action":{"icon":"plus","label":"Add a plant","goto":"new_plant"}}
weight: 1

Calendar: See which dates have something planned and open a day.
props: { style?: week|month="week", month: text≤16, marked: [0..12 { day: int 1..31, tone?: neutral|good|warn|bad="neutral" }], selected?: int 1..31, start?: int 1..7=1, days?: int 28..31=30 }

Timeline: Events in time order, or activities sized by duration on an hour rail.
props: { density?: comfortable|compact, detail?: full|brief="full", style?: day|history|hours="day", items: [1..8 { tone?: neutral|good|warn|bad="neutral", time: text≤12, title: text≤32, meta?: text≤32, done?: boolean=false, end?: time HH:MM, goto?: id snake_case }] }
Rule: Use day for a schedule of events with only single times, even if some are already done. Use history for an explicitly past-only log. Either takes up to six items. To show time and title only, set detail brief and keep supplied notes in meta.
Rule: Use hours for duration blocks on an hour rail: up to eight items, time as the start in HH:MM and a later end in HH:MM. Only hours uses end and goto; omit meta and done in hours.
Rule: Set density, detail and each event tone to null unless explicitly requested. Times, notes, completion and scheduling are data, not requests for a variant.
example: {"c":"Timeline","style":"history","items":[{"time":"Mon","title":"Watered fern","meta":"Bathroom · Ledge","done":true},{"time":"Wed","title":"Repotted basil","meta":"Kitchen","done":true}]}

Write one complete phone screen as JSON: {id,title?,components:[{id,c,...props}]}. Use unique snake_case ids for components; never put ids on array items. Use only listed props. Use null for absent optional fields, never write empty strings.

Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).
density: comfortable|compact
emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined
align: start|center
bleed: inset|edge
aspect: auto|square|wide|tall
detail: full|brief
media: none|icon|thumb|cover
figures: exact|short
labels: key|none|all
arrange: rows|grid|strip
group: none|sections|dates
overflow: all|peek|page
lead: none|icon|avatar|thumb|number|check
trail: none|chevron|value|badge|toggle|check
tone: neutral|good|warn|bad
mark: none|highlight|muted|new

An explicit layout rule can request an axis. Catalog examples show JSON shape, not requested styling. Never infer an axis from the data alone. Variant limits: one hero emphasis and one cover collection per screen.

Real app content: {"things":[{"type":"message","fields":["sender","text"]}],"items":[{"id":"anna","type":"message","sample":true,"sender":"Anna","text":"Can Clover's walk start at 09:30?"},{"id":"reply","type":"message","sample":true,"sender":"Me","text":"09:30 works, see you then."}]}

Header: Name the screen and offer one optional shortcut.
props: { density?: comfortable|compact, emphasis?: normal|quiet="normal", detail?: full|brief="full", style?: back, title: text≤28, sub?: text≤40, action?: { icon: dot|leaf|drop|dog|cat|calendar|calendar_days|clock|check|chevron_right|plus|minus|close|search|settings|bell|bell_off|heart|star|bookmark|share|send|message|mail|phone|camera|image|video|mic|music|play|pause|square|undo|timer|alarm_clock|sun|moon|cloud|cloud_rain|thermometer|wind|flame|zap|battery|wifi|pin|map|navigation|compass|home|building|store|shopping_cart|shopping_bag|tag|gift|credit_card|wallet|banknote|piggy_bank|receipt|trending_up|trending_down|bar_chart|pie_chart|activity|target|trophy|medal|award|flag|user|users|user_plus|baby|smile|dumbbell|bike|footprints|heart_pulse|pill|stethoscope|apple|coffee|utensils|wine|pizza|carrot|sprout|flower|tree|mountain|waves|car|bus|plane|train|briefcase|graduation_cap|book_open|book|pencil|file_text|clipboard|clipboard_list|checklist|lock|unlock|key|shield|eye|link|paperclip|download|upload|trash|edit|filter|sliders|info|alert|help|sparkles|lightbulb|palette|scissors|wrench|hammer|package|truck|recycle|globe|languages|gamepad|ticket|paw|shirt|bed|bath|sofa|lamp|chevron_left|arrow_left|more|external_link|quote|circle_check, label: text≤16, goto?: id snake_case } }
Rule: Use style "back" only when a back button is needed. To hide a subtitle, use detail "brief" and keep the supplied subtitle in sub. Hiding it does not request a smaller title or a denser header: set emphasis and density to null unless the brief explicitly asks for those changes.
example: {"c":"Header","title":"My plants","sub":"Three need water today","action":{"icon":"plus","label":"Add a plant","goto":"new_plant"}}
weight: 1

Bubbles: A conversation between you and someone else, with each person's messages kept distinct.
props: { detail?: full|brief="full", messages: [1..6 { from: me|them, text: text≤120 }], with?: text≤24 }
Rule: Leave detail null unless asked to retain a supplied conversation partner in "with" without showing their name above the messages. Then use detail "brief". Keep all messages.
example: {"c":"Bubbles","with":"Maya","messages":[{"from":"them","text":"Have you watered the fern today?"},{"from":"them","text":"The soil felt dry this morning."},{"from":"me","text":"Yes, I watered it after breakfast."},{"from":"me","text":"I'll check the basil tomorrow."},{"from":"them","text":"Perfect, thank you!"}]}
weight: 2

Composer: Write several lines of text: an entry, a note, a review or a reply.
props: { style?: entry|reply="entry", label?: text≤24, hint: text≤60, max?: int 80..2000=600, value?: text≤2000 }
example: {"c":"Composer","style":"entry","label":"Today's note","hint":"How did the plants look today?","max":400}
weight: 2

A valid default for this layout: {"id":"chat_thread","components":[{"id":"h1","c":"Header","title":"Message"},{"id":"b1","c":"Bubbles","messages":[{"from":"them","text":"Can Clover's walk start at 09:30?"}]},{"id":"c1","c":"Composer","style":"reply","hint":"sender"}]}

Use the supplied facts, not content from examples. Do not invent dates, status, measurements, or zero values for missing data. Keep all components focused on the screen's job; give the main action a clear label and avoid duplicate or unrelated actions. Reply with JSON only.

Write one complete phone screen as JSON: {id,title?,components:[{id,c,...props}]}. Use unique snake_case ids for components; never put ids on array items. Use only listed props. Use null for absent optional fields, never write empty strings.

Layout: checklist/simple. Job: Independent jobs to tick off.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Checklist"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Note"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot4","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).
density: comfortable|compact
emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined
align: start|center
bleed: inset|edge
aspect: auto|square|wide|tall
detail: full|brief
media: none|icon|thumb|cover
figures: exact|short
labels: key|none|all
arrange: rows|grid|strip
group: none|sections|dates
overflow: all|peek|page
lead: none|icon|avatar|thumb|number|check
trail: none|chevron|value|badge|toggle|check
tone: neutral|good|warn|bad
mark: none|highlight|muted|new

Layout: success/plain. Job: Proof that an action worked.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Success"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["KeyValue"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Button"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).

surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined
align: start|center
bleed: inset|edge

Match every required slot in order. Layout: profile/person. Job: Me or the person this screen is about.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Profile"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Stats"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot4","allow":["List"],"min":1,"max":1}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).
density: comfortable|compact
emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined
align: start|center
bleed: inset|edge
aspect: auto|square|wide|tall
detail: full|brief
media: none|icon|thumb|cover
figures: exact|short
labels: key|none|all
arrange: rows|grid|strip
group: none|sections|dates
overflow: all|peek|page
lead: none|icon|avatar|thumb|number|check
trail: none|chevron|value|badge|toggle|check
tone: neutral|good|warn|bad
mark: none|highlight|muted|new

An explicit layout rule can request an axis. Catalog examples show JSON shape, not requested styling. Never infer an axis from the data alone. Variant limits: one hero emphasis and one cover collection per screen.

Layout rule: Choose one supplied record as the subject when no subject is named. Header and Profile identify that same subject, not the entire collection. Use Stats for supported measurements, not guesses. In the List, show related records or supporting details that are not already in Profile; leave overflow, detail and mark null.

Write one complete phone screen as JSON: {id,title?,components:[{id,c,...props}]}. Use unique snake_case ids for components; never put ids on array items. Use only listed props. Use null for absent optional fields, never write empty strings.

Layout: chat/thread. Job: A conversation with a place to reply.

Recipe slots: [{"id":"slot1","allow":["Header"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot2","allow":["Bubbles"],"min":1,"max":1},{"id":"slot3","allow":["Composer"],"min":1,"max":1,"variant":"reply"}]. Match every required slot in order. Variants such as shelf, reply, month or mood are the component's style; Field/Camera variants are kind. prices means every Choice option has a price value; toggle means every List row has trail: toggle.

Screen rules: three to nine components outside overlays, total weight at most twelve, at most two weight-three components. One primary Button at most. Hero first in the body; a SectionTitle needs following content. Repeated types cannot be adjacent except Card and Field. Reply Composer is last after Bubbles. Do not invent color, size or layout props.

Set shared axes, including item axes, only when explicitly requested; otherwise use null. At most one third of items per component get mark "highlight" (round down).
density: comfortable|compact
emphasis: quiet|normal|hero
surface: plain|card|tinted|outlined
align: start|center
bleed: inset|edge
aspect: auto|square|wide|tall
detail: full|brief
media: none|icon|thumb|cover
figures: exact|short
labels: key|none|all
arrange: rows|grid|strip
group: none|sections|dates
overflow: all|peek|page
lead: none|icon|avatar|thumb|number|check
trail: none|chevron|value|badge|toggle|check
tone: neutral|good|warn|bad
mark: none|highlight|muted|new

An explicit layout rule can request an axis. Catalog examples show JSON shape, not requested styling. Never infer an axis from the data alone. Variant limits: one hero emphasis and one cover collection per screen.

Real app content: {"things":[{"type":"message","fields":["sender","text"]}],"items":[{"id":"anna","type":"message","sample":true,"sender":"Anna","text":"Can Clover's walk start at 09:30?"},{"id":"reply","type":"message","sample":true,"sender":"Me","text":"09:30 works, see you then."}]}

Header: Name the screen and offer one optional shortcut.
props: { density?: comfortable|compact, emphasis?: normal|quiet="normal", detail?: full|brief="full", style?: back, title: text≤28, sub?: text≤40, action?: { icon: dot|leaf|drop|dog|cat|calendar|calendar_days|clock|check|chevron_right|plus|minus|close|search|settings|bell|bell_off|heart|star|bookmark|share|send|message|mail|phone|camera|image|video|mic|music|play|pause|square|undo|timer|alarm_clock|sun|moon|cloud|cloud_rain|thermometer|wind|flame|zap|battery|wifi|pin|map|navigation|compass|home|building|store|shopping_cart|shopping_bag|tag|gift|credit_card|wallet|banknote|piggy_bank|receipt|trending_up|trending_down|bar_chart|pie_chart|activity|target|trophy|medal|award|flag|user|users|user_plus|baby|smile|dumbbell|bike|footprints|heart_pulse|pill|stethoscope|apple|coffee|utensils|wine|pizza|carrot|sprout|flower|tree|mountain|waves|car|bus|plane|train|briefcase|graduation_cap|book_open|book|pencil|file_text|clipboard|clipboard_list|checklist|lock|unlock|key|shield|eye|link|paperclip|download|upload|trash|edit|filter|sliders|info|alert|help|sparkles|lightbulb|palette|scissors|wrench|hammer|package|truck|recycle|globe|languages|gamepad|ticket|paw|shirt|bed|bath|sofa|lamp|chevron_left|arrow_left|more|external_link|quote|circle_check, label: text≤16, goto?: id snake_case } }
Rule: Use style "back" only when a back button is needed. To hide a subtitle, use detail "brief" and keep the supplied subtitle in sub. Hiding it does not request a smaller title or a denser header: set emphasis and density to null unless the brief explicitly asks for those changes.
example: {"c":"Header","title":"My plants","sub":"Three need water today","action":{"icon":"plus","label":"Add a plant","goto":"new_plant"}}
weight: 1

Bubbles: A conversation between you and someone else, with each person's messages kept distinct.
props: { detail?: full|brief="full", messages: [1..6 { from: me|them, text: text≤120 }], with?: text≤24 }
Rule: Leave detail null unless asked to retain a supplied conversation partner in "with" without showing their name above the messages. Then use detail "brief". Keep all messages.
example: {"c":"Bubbles","with":"Maya","messages":[{"from":"them","text":"Have you watered the fern today?"},{"from":"them","text":"The soil felt dry this morning."},{"from":"me","text":"Yes, I watered it after breakfast."},{"from":"me","text":"I'll check the basil tomorrow."},{"from":"them","text":"Perfect, thank you!"}]}
weight: 2

Composer: Write several lines of text: an entry, a note, a review or a reply.
props: { detail?: full|brief="full", style?: entry|reply="entry", label?: text≤24, hint: text≤60, max?: int 80..2000=600, value?: text≤2000 }
Rule: “No character counter below the entry box” means detail "brief". Keep the limit in max; do not show the count or move the limit into label or hint. Otherwise use null, including for replies.
example: {"c":"Composer","style":"entry","label":"Today's note","hint":"How did the plants look today?","max":400}
weight: 2

A valid default for this layout: {"id":"chat_thread","components":[{"id":"h1","c":"Header","title":"Message"},{"id":"b1","c":"Bubbles","messages":[{"from":"them","text":"Can Clover's walk start at 09:30?"}]},{"id":"c1","c":"Composer","style":"reply","hint":"sender"}]}

Use the supplied facts, not content from examples. Do not invent dates, status, measurements, or zero values for missing data. Keep all components focused on the screen's job; give the main action a clear label and avoid duplicate or unrelated actions. Reply with JSON only.

Rule: To hide only the secondary caption, write detail "brief", density null, and emphasis null, and still store the caption in sub. Defaults such as comfortable and normal are not requests; a large focal ring uses emphasis "hero".

Leave emphasis null unless the request asks to change prominence, even if "normal" is listed.

Density changes spacing only. Use null to inherit app spacing unless the request asks for tighter or roomier spacing. Showing fewer rows, hiding details, and shortening text do not change spacing.

Keep requested content visible. Leave detail null when the default already shows the requested content, or when there is no extra content to hide. Set detail only if the request asks to hide or reveal existing content and the default does not do that. Read-only changes actions, not visibility.

Use the supplied facts, not content from examples. Do not invent dates, status, measurements, or zero values for missing data. Keep all components focused on the screen's job; give the main action a clear label and avoid duplicate or unrelated actions.
